items.text: Not warm. Ice and snow are cold.
Night is when it is dark and you sleep.
Artus is the boy in the story.
Pip is the little orange dragon. He is Artus’s friend.
Jet is Pip’s cousin. He is a little red dragon.
Your mum’s mum or your dad’s mum. Here she is Jet’s grandma.
A house is a home. People live in a house.
Made means make, but in the past.
Hot means very warm. The sun is hot.
Soup is hot food that you eat with a spoon.
Ate means eat, but in the past.
Hot, bright flames. A fire keeps you warm.
As big as means just the same size as. A tomato as big as Pip!
A horse is a big animal. You can sit on its back.
Could not means he was not able to.
To sit is to be on a chair or on the ground.
On his back means behind him, on his body.
To fly is to move in the air, like a bird.
Not yet means not now, but later.
Had means have, but in the past.
Strong means you can carry big, heavy things.
Wings help a bird or a dragon fly.
Over means across, from one side to the other.
Trees are big plants with leaves.
Time is how long something takes.
After means later. First this, and after that, the next thing.
Dinner is the food you eat in the evening.
New means you did not have it before.
A trick is something clever that you do. It can fool someone.
Flew means fly, but in the past. The bird flew away.
Up means to a higher place.
The roof is the top of a house.
Down means to a lower place.
Very means a lot. Very big is bigger than big.
To look is to use your eyes.
Said means say, but in the past.
Best means better than all the others.
Flying means going through the air, like a bird.
A big animal with wings. Some dragons can make fire.
Land is the ground, not the water.
Only means just this one, no more.
Laughed means laugh, in the past. Ha, ha!
A story tells you about things that happen. You can read a story in a book.
About tells you what something is on. A story about owls.
Dark means there is no light.
A wizard is a person who can do magic.
Wanted means want, in the past.
Magic can make strange and wonderful things happen.
By himself means with no help.
Around means all the way round. They fly around the room.
A room is one part of a house, with walls and a door.
To hit is to bump into something hard. Ouch!
Went means go, but in the past.
The floor is the ground in a room. You walk on the floor.
Oh is what you say when you are surprised.
Looked means look, but in the past. Here: her face showed how she felt.
Next means the one after this. Next to means close by.
You say please when you ask for something nicely.
Outside means out of a house or a room.
Real means it is true, not pretend.
Asked means ask, but in the past. She asked a question.
Old means not new. It is from long ago.
A bed is where you sleep at night.
To sleep is to close your eyes and rest at night.
A window is glass in a wall. You can look out of it.
Because tells you why. I am happy because it is sunny.
To see is to use your eyes.
The moon is big and round, and it gives light in the night sky.
Got Jet down means they helped him come down.
Warm means a little hot. Nice, not cold.
Soon means after a short time.
Slept means sleep, but in the past.
Quiet means with very little sound.
The middle is the part in the centre, not at the side.
Woke means wake, in the past. He woke up in the morning.
A sound is something you hear.
Rain is water that falls from clouds.
Came means come, but in the past.
Stopped means stop, in the past. The books have stopped.
Sat means sit, but in the past. They sat down.
Saw means see, but in the past.
Black is the colour of the night sky.
Smoke is the grey or black air that comes from a fire.
Coming means getting near, on the way here.
You open a door to go into a house or out of it.
Why asks for a reason. Why are you sad?
To laugh is to make a happy sound when something is funny.
To think is to use your mind.
Why did Grandma laugh at Jet?
Why did Artus think the sound was the rain?
Jumped means went up into the air from the ground.
Out means not in. They went outside.
To wake up means to stop sleeping.
At once means all of it, very fast.
A flame is the hot, bright part of a fire.
Your mouth is where you eat and talk.
Wind is air that moves. You can feel it blow.
Lights are things that shine and help you see.
A man is a grown-up boy.
Stood means stand, but in the past.
Tall means very high, like a big tree.
Thin means not fat. A thin stick.
Long means it takes a lot of time, or it goes far.
A coat is warm clothes you wear over your other clothes.
Your eyes are what you see with.
Green is the colour of grass and leaves.
To like something means you think it is nice.
A cat is a small animal with soft fur. It says miaow.
Your voice is the sound you make when you talk.
Your name is what people call you.
Grax is the dark wizard in this story. He wants all the dragon fire.
What is a question word. What is that?
To want something means you would like to have it.
Smiled means made a happy face.
Kind means good to others. You help them.
A smile is the happy face you make when you are glad.
Held means hold, but in the past. Artus held the torch.
Your hand is at the end of your arm. You hold things with your hand.
A ball is round. You can play with a ball.
Help! means: please come and help me!
To get means to go and take something.
Ran means run, in the past.
The sun is the big bright light in the sky in the day.
The sky is above you. The sun and stars are in the sky.
A cloud is white or grey and floats in the sky. Inside a cloud you can not see far.
Away means to another place, not here. Go away!
Mountains are very, very big hills.
Your face is the front of your head, with your eyes, nose and mouth.
White is the colour of snow and clouds.
To tell is to say something to someone.
More means extra. A bigger amount.
Stories are tales about people and things.
Cried means had tears in the eyes.
Your cousin is the child of your aunt or uncle.
A friend is someone you like, and who likes you.
To know is to have it in your head. I know the way.
How asks the way to do something. How can we get there?
To feel is to know something with your body or your heart. I feel cold. I feel happy.
The end is the last part of something.
How did Artus know the smoke was magic?
Why did Pip’s flame not help Jet?
How did Pip feel at the end of the night?
Morning is the start of the day.
Sad means not happy. You feel like you want to cry.
To eat is to put food in your mouth.
To find is to look and then see the thing you want.
To stop is to not go on.
Until means up to the time when.
To need something is to have to have it.
Oren is a very old wizard. He lives in a tall tower.
Knows means know. Grandma knows about the moon.
The time when the sun is up.
Fields are big pieces of land with grass or food on them.
Along means on, going the long way. Walk along the road.
A river is a long, long line of water that goes to the ocean.
A tower is a very tall, thin building.
Gus is a friendly giant. He lives on a big farm.
A giant is a very, very big person, as tall as a tree.
The way is how you go to a place.
Grass is green, and it grows on the ground.
Grey is the colour of rain clouds.
Flowers are the pretty, bright parts of a plant.
A farmer has a farm. A farmer grows food and has animals.
A field is a big open place with grass or food plants.
Going means moving to a place.
Every means all of them, one by one.
Goes means go. The boat goes down the river.
Whispered means said very, very quietly.
Ago means before now. A long time ago.
To rescue means to save someone from danger.
A book has pages with words and pictures.
A plan is what you think you will do.
Lives means has a home. Grax lives in a castle.
A castle is a big, strong house of stone. Kings and queens have castles.
An island is land with water all round it.
The sea is a lot of salty water, as far as you can see.
A journey is a long way to go, from one place to another.
Through means in one side and out the other side.
Wild means not tame. Nobody looks after a wild animal.
A forest is a place with lots and lots of trees.
Sand is very small bits of stone. There is sand on the beach.
A very, very big hill. It is high and has rocks.
Brave means you do the right thing, even when you are afraid.
To say is to tell something with words.
What did the farmer say made the land grey?
A box is a thing with sides and a top. You can put things in it.
Took means take, but in the past.
Silver is a shiny grey metal.
A torch is a light you carry in your hand.
Its means it has it. The fox has a red tail: its tail is red.
Light helps you see. The sun gives light.
Other means a different one, not this one.
Tricks are clever things that fool someone.
Lies are things that people say that are not true.
Does is a form of do. What does it do?
Work is a job that you do.
To hold is to have something in your hands.
To show is to let someone see something.
Three is the number after two. One, two, three.
Times means how many. Three times means one, two, three.
To use something means to do a job with it.
Well means in a good way. You work well.
Heavy means it is hard to pick up.
To put is to move something to a place.
You carry things in a bag.
Food is what you eat, like bread and cheese.
You make toast and sandwiches with bread.
Cheese is a food made from milk.
Apples are round fruit. They can be red or green.
Cake is a sweet food. You can have cake on your birthday.
Each means every one. They looked at each other.
First means before all the others. Number one.
To come is to move to here.
Us means me and you, or me and my friends.
To wish means to want something very much.
Without means not with. We can’t do it without the pages.
You drink water. Rain is water.
If tells you what will happen when something else happens.
To call is to give a name. I will call you Pip.
The top is the highest part.
A bowl is a round dish for soup or cake.
A picture is something you can see on paper or in water.
Red is the colour of fire and of some apples.
A candle is a stick of wax with a small flame on top.
Here, still means the path keeps going for a long way.
Bright means full of light. The sun is bright.
A lot means very much, or very many.
Your hands are at the end of your arms.
Your head is the top part of you, with your eyes, nose and mouth.
To remember is to think of something from before.
To believe someone means to think that what they say is true.
Both means the two of them.
Began means begin, but in the past. They started.
What can the silver torch do?
Why can’t Gus come on the journey?
What did they see in Oren’s magic water?
Two is the number after one.
Days means more than one day.
Close means near. Walk close to me.
Birds are animals with wings and feathers.
Called means call, but in the past. He shouted a name.
Monkeys are animals that live in trees and jump from tree to tree.
Leaves are the green parts of a tree. One leaf, two leaves.
To follow means to go after someone or something.
Followed means went after someone or something.
Deep means a long way in or a long way down.
A path is a small way to walk on.
Heard means hear, but in the past. You hear with your ears.
Orange is a colour, like the colour of fire and of an orange.
A tiger is a big orange cat with black lines.
To move is to go from one place to another.
Who asks about a person. Who are you?
Or means one thing, or the other thing.
An enemy is someone who wants to hurt you or stop you.
Friends are people you like, and who like you.
Our means it is for us. Our friend is Jet.
Walked means walk, in the past.
Behind means at the back. Pip hides behind the door.
To make is to put things together, so there is a new thing.
To walk is to go on your feet, not fast.
Dragons are big animals with wings. Some dragons can make fire.
To hide is to go where no one can see you.
Happy means you feel good and glad.
How did they know which way to go?
Why did the tiger help them?
Knew means know, but in the past.
A tree is a big plant with a trunk and leaves.
A stone is a little rock.
Angry means very cross. You feel hot and you want to shout.
Your nose is on your face. You smell with it.
To drink is to take water into your mouth.
Has means have. She has a castle.
Clean means with no dirt on it.
Blue is the colour of the sky on a sunny day.
Things are objects, or what happens.
An animal is a living thing like a cat, a dog or a tiger.
Legs are what animals and people walk on.
Ears are on your head. You hear with your ears.
An okapi is a forest animal with a brown body and black and white legs.
Creatures are animals, big or small, real or magic.
Sent means made someone or something go.
Your feet are at the end of your legs. You stand on your feet.
To run is to go very fast on your feet.
Late means after the right time.
Their means it is for them. The owls can’t see their food.
A spell is magic words that make magic happen.
Kept means keep, in the past. He kept Jet warm.
You say thank you when someone is kind to you.
A place is where something is.
What is a place like when Grax takes its magic?
What did Pip’s fire do to the black river?
What stopped the smoke creatures first?
Thirsty means you want a drink of water.
Gave means give, but in the past. She gave them a map.
Some means a few, or a little.
Later means after now, at another time.
A camel is a big animal with a hump on its back. It can walk a long way on hot sand.
Purple is a colour. You make it with red and blue.
Stars are small bright lights in the night sky.
A small bright light in the night sky.
Lost means you can not find it.
A lake is a lot of still water with land all around it.
Drank means drink, but in the past. Pip drank the water.
Thought means think, but in the past.
A camp is a place with tents where you sleep outside.
A tent is a little house made of cloth. You sleep in it at a camp.
Beautiful means very, very nice to look at.
Walking means going on your feet.
Why did Artus think the camel was lost?
What did Pip say about Jet and the camel?
Tired means you want to rest or sleep.
Rook is a young man in a grey coat. He works for Grax.
A cage is a box made of bars. You can not get out of a cage.
To hurt is to do something bad to someone that gives them pain.
To hear is to use your ears.
A secret is something only you know.
A tunnel is a way under the ground.
To take is to get something and hold it, or go with it.
A person is a man, a woman or a child.
Such means so. Such a strong wizard means a very strong wizard.
To keep is to have something and not give it away.
Funny means it makes you laugh.
What story did Rook tell them?
Why did Artus not use the torch on Rook?
What did Artus see in Rook’s hand at night?
The ground is what you stand on outside.
Led means showed the way. Rook led them.
A side is the left or the right of something.
To push means to move something away from you.
Pushed means moved something away with your hands or head.
Hard means not easy. It can also mean not soft.
To lead means to go first and show the way.
Walls are the sides of a room or a castle.
While means at the same time. The book is still while he reads.
Ways are paths, or how to go.
Found means find, but in the past.
What did Rook do when the tunnel went two ways?
A creature is an animal, big or small, real or magic.
Horns are hard, pointed things on the head of some animals.
A triceratops is a big dinosaur with three horns.
Noses are on faces. Animals smell with their noses.
A chain is a line of metal rings, joined together.
Keeps means keep. She keeps the ship safe.
People means men, women and children.
Broke means went into pieces. The chain broke.
Last means after all the others. The end.
Careful means you go slowly and look, so nothing bad happens.
Below means under, lower down. The stones are below the water.
Why was the triceratops not angry any more?
Why was the triceratops in the tunnel?
What did the triceratops say about Rook?
A bridge goes over water, so you can get to the other side.
Gone means not here any more.
Waves are water that goes up and down on the ocean.
To fall is to go down fast, by mistake.
Fell means fall, in the past. He fell down.
To break means to go into pieces.
A hole is an open place in something, where water can come in.
To jump is to go up into the air with your legs.
A bird is an animal with wings and feathers. Most birds can fly.
A pelican is a big sea bird. It has a very big mouth to carry fish.
What did Pip see about Rook on the bridge?
How did they get over the hole in the bridge?
Windows are the glass in a wall that you can see out of.
A moment is a very short time.
Boom is a big, loud sound, like a giant walking.
A trap is a trick to catch someone.
A lie is something that is not true.
Never means not at any time.
Anything means any thing at all.
To give is to let someone have something.
Gold is a yellow, very bright metal. Crowns and coins can be gold.
A crown is a gold ring that a king or a queen has on the head.
What was in the cage in the long room?
Where asks about a place. Where is the moon?
Air is all around us. We breathe air, and the wind is moving air.
To open is to make a way in. Open the door!
What did the silver torch show about the smoke?
Why was Pip angry with Rook?
A wall is the side of a room, a house or a castle.
To listen means to hear something on purpose.
High means a long way up.
Low means near the ground, not high.
Stairs are steps that go up and down in a house or a tower.
To try means to do your best.
Voices are the sounds of people when they talk.
How did Pip find the right stone?
Why did Artus not believe Grax?
To climb is to go up, with your hands and feet.
Climbed means went up, using hands and feet.
A storm is a lot of wind and rain, and sometimes thunder.
A fish lives in water and swims.
Round is the shape of a ball or a coin. Round and round means in a circle.
Half means one of two parts that are the same size.
Full means there is no more room.
Cages are boxes made of bars. Birds in cages can not fly away.
Taken means took, someone got it.
What does a wind fish do when a storm is coming?
What did Grax have in the room half way up?
To wait is to stay here until something happens.
Second means number two. First, second. A second is also a very short time.
Glass is hard, and you can see through it. Windows are glass.
A key opens a door or a lock.
To ring a bell is to make it go ding, ding.
Great means very big, or very good.
Making means building or doing something now.
Ready means you can start now.
To shout means to say something very loud.
Why did Artus use the torch before going to the cage?
Why was Jet weak and tired?
Who has the key to the cage?
Silly means funny, not very clever.
A boy is a child who will grow up to be a man.
Felt means feel, but in the past. Artus felt sad.
Money is what you use to buy things.
Hungry means you want to eat.
Midnight is twelve o’clock at night, in the middle of the night.
A staff is a long stick. Wizards use a staff for magic.
A piece is a small part of something.
Paper is what you write on. The pages of a book are paper.
A map is a picture that shows you the way to go.
Thinks means think. Pip thinks of a good idea.
Looks means look. He looks out of the window.
What did Rook hear Grax say about him?
What will Grax do at midnight?
Looking means using your eyes to find something.
A hill is like a little mountain.
Let me help means please can I help.
Worst means more bad than all the others.
A thing is an object, or something that happens.
To care means to think a person or a thing is important.
To leave means to go away from a place or a person.
How did Grax know about Artus and Pip?
What did Grax choose to do when Rook shouted?
What did Pip say they will never do?
A boat takes you over water. A boat is smaller than a ship.
An octopus is a sea animal with eight long legs.
Biggest means more big than all the others.
A rock is a big, hard stone.
Why did Pip not like going in the sea?
How did Pip feel at the end?
Third means number three. First, second, third.
Always means every time, all the time.
Gets means get. He gets the rope.
Life is all the time you are alive.
A thousand is ten hundreds. 1,000. A lot!
Pieces are small parts of something.
The big BOOM you hear in a storm.
A bright flash of light in the sky in a storm.
Ever means at any time. For ever means for all time.
How many times did the silver torch work in all?
What came out when the staff broke?
What did they find on the rock?
To love is to like something very, very much.
Jumping means going up into the air with your feet.
Home is the place where you live.
A phoenix is a magic bird of fire.
How was the island different after the storm?
A party is a happy time with friends, food and games.
A table has legs and a flat top. You eat at a table.
Across means from one side to the other. Walk across the road.
A word is a group of letters that means something. Cat is a word.
Worried means you think something bad may happen, and you feel upset.
Comes means come. The owl comes in.
To meet means to come together with someone.
To cry is to have tears coming out of your eyes when you are sad.
What did the ring do at the very end?
